periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique angle directed downwards toward the muzzle at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.4:1 from the camera perspective.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward elongation where the lowest point is significantly distal to the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shaped curvature on the posterior edge of the thoracic band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial lateral thickness, covering approximately 40% of the visible thoracic region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance between ears, roughly 1.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semicircular curvature across the superior edges of the pinnae.
